source.title: Forebears Benin forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to seed localized given names and surnames. Gender grouping follows the public gender field for high-frequency forenames; this is not an official civil registry dataset.

source.title: ITU Operational Bulletin: Benin national numbering plan communication of 24.IV.2024

phones.notes: ITU/ARCEP confirms country code +229, migration to ten-digit national significant numbers, and mobile assigned ranges including 0140-0147, 0150-0169 and 0190-0199 except unassigned 0192/0193. Numbers are synthetic and not checked for live assignment or portability.

source.title: Benin Ministry of Living Environment asphaltage project city list

locations.notes: Official project source confirms key city names used in the dataset. Department-city mapping is conventional public geography; street names and postal prefixes remain sample/synthetic because Benin does not use national postcodes in the same way as many countries and public postal-office prefixes require separate authoritative coverage.

national_personal_identification_number.label: National Personal Identification Number

source.title: ANIP Carte Nationale d'Identite Biometrique specimen

national_personal_identification_number.notes: ANIP public CNIB specimen displays a ten-digit NPI example, and ANIP describes the CNIB as based on the personal identification number. No public rule, checksum, semantic digits or allocated-range validation was found, so generation remains a synthetic numeric template.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Benin ordinary passport document entries

passport.notes: PRADO confirms Benin ordinary passport document versions, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the passport number grammar. The template is retained only as a conservative synthetic placeholder until multiple public samples or an official number-format rule are available.
